article.title: Iranian satirist Saeed Shakiba gets five years for Khamenei impersonation
paras: Editor's note: this story was translated from the original VOA Persian article.

Saeed Shakiba, an Iranian blogger and satirist who was arrested after posting a satirical video impersonating late Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei’s voice, has been sentenced to five years in prison by a Tehran Revolutionary Court.

The Human Rights Activists News Agency (HRANA) reported on Friday that Branch 28 of the Tehran Revolutionary Court issued the sentence on the alleged charge of “assembly and collusion against national security.” Shakiba is being held at Greater Tehran Penitentiary.
The Hengaw Organization for Human Rights also confirmed the report, saying that Shakiba’s hearing took place last week and that the verdict was delivered to him in prison.

Saeed Shakiba was arrested in mid-October after posting a satirical video on social media in which he imitated the voice of Ali Khamenei, the Iranian Supreme Leader who was killed during the joint U.S.-Israeli military operation against the regime.

Following the video's publication, Mizan News Agency, which is affiliated with Iran’s judiciary, announced that a case had been opened against a blogger, describing the published content as “insulting and abusive.”

On October 25, the agency also reported that an indictment had been issued in the case. A statement from the judiciary cited several alleged charges during the proceedings, including insulting officials, propaganda against the state, and supporting Israel.
According to HRANA, however, Shakiba’s five-year prison sentence was issued on the alleged charge of “assembly and collusion against national security.”

The satirist’s conviction comes after the U.S. State Department documented severe restrictions on freedom of expression and the prosecution of critics of the Islamic Republic in its 2023 annual human rights report on Iran.
The report said Iranian authorities use criminal laws to intimidate and prosecute people who criticize the government, the Islamic Republic’s leader, or official policies.

The State Department also noted that Iran’s security and judicial institutions have, in some cases, used citizens’ remarks and social media posts as grounds for bringing national security charges against them.

The report further cited the arrest and punishment of government critics, restrictions on media activity, and censorship of online content among the violations of freedom of expression in the Islamic Republic.
zh: 伊朗諷刺作家賽義德·沙基巴因模仿哈梅內伊被判處五年徒刑
編者註：本報導翻譯自美國之音波斯語版原文。
伊朗部落客兼諷刺作家薩伊德·沙基巴（Saeed Shakiba）因發布一段模仿已故最高領袖阿里·哈梅內伊聲音的諷刺影片而遭逮捕，現已被德黑蘭革命法院判處五年有期徒刑。
人權活動家新聞社（HRANA）週五報導，德黑蘭革命法院第28分庭針對「集結及串謀危害國家安全」的指控作出了判決。沙基巴目前被羈押於大德黑蘭監獄。
「亨加人權組織」也證實了這則報導，並表示沙基巴的聽證會於上週舉行，判決結果已於獄中送達給他。
薩伊德·沙基巴（Saeed Shakiba）於十月中旬因在社群媒體上發布一段諷刺影片而被捕，該影片中他模仿了伊朗最高領袖阿里·哈梅內伊的聲音；哈梅內伊是在美國與以色列針對該政權發動的聯合軍事行動中喪生的。
該影片發布後，隸屬於伊朗司法機關的米贊通訊社宣布，已針對一名部落客展開調查，並將該部落客發布的內容描述為「侮辱性且具攻擊性」。
10月25日，該機構亦報導稱，本案已發出起訴書。司法機關發表的聲明中列舉了審理過程中提出的數項指控，包括侮辱公職人員、反國家宣傳以及支持以色列。
然而，根據 HRANA 的說法，沙基巴被判處五年有期徒刑，罪名是涉嫌「集會及串謀危害國家安全」。
這位諷刺作家被判有罪，此前美國國務院在其2023年關於伊朗的年度人權報告中，已記錄了該國對言論自由的嚴厲限制，以及對伊斯蘭共和國批評者的起訴。
該報告指出，伊朗當局利用刑法來威嚇及起訴那些批評政府、伊斯蘭共和國領導人或官方政策的人士。
美國國務院還指出，伊朗的安全和司法機構在某些情況下，曾將公民的言論和社群媒體貼文作為對其提出國家安全指控的依據。
該報告進一步指出，在伊斯蘭共和國侵犯言論自由的行為中，包括逮捕及懲處政府批評者、限制媒體活動，以及對網路內容實施審查等。
